topic.name: 蜡块运动的合成与分解
topic.title: 蜡块向上，玻璃管向右，合起来往哪里走？
topic.question: 蜡块向上，玻璃管向右，合起来往哪里走？
topic.description: 密封水管中的红蜡块与横向移管使用同一个时钟，对比两个匀速分运动与横向加速时的轨迹。
topic.tag: 分运动 · 同时性 · 合成

zh: 蜡块运动的合成与分解
en: Composing the motion of a wax float

translations.蜡块运动的合成与分解: Composing the motion of a wax float
translations.蜡块向上，玻璃管向右，合起来往哪里走？: The wax rises and the tube moves right: what is the combined motion?
translations.密封水管中的红蜡块与横向移管使用同一个时钟，对比两个匀速分运动与横向加速时的轨迹: One clock drives the red wax float and the translating water-filled tube; compare uniform components with accelerated horizontal motion.
translations.倒置密封玻璃管，等蜡块上升趋于稳定: Invert the sealed tube and wait for the rise speed to settle
translations.横向加速，纵向匀速，合运动变成曲线: Horizontal acceleration and uniform rise produce a curved path
translations.两个方向同时匀速，蜡块沿斜直线移动: Uniform motion in both directions produces a straight diagonal path
translations.玻璃管 · 红蜡块 · 黑板坐标: Glass tube · Red wax · Blackboard coordinates
translations.密封装水玻璃管水平移动，红蜡块竖直上升，背景坐标记录合运动: A sealed water-filled tube moves horizontally as red wax rises; background coordinates record the combined motion
translations.刚开始上升会加速；后面的合成分析从近似匀速阶段开始。: The float accelerates initially; composition analysis begins after its rise becomes approximately uniform.
translations.每秒竖直位移相同，水平位移逐次增大，轨迹随之弯曲。: Equal vertical increments and growing horizontal increments create a curved trajectory.
translations.同一时刻把水平和竖直位移合起来，才是蜡块相对黑板的位置。: Combine horizontal and vertical displacements at the same instant to locate the wax relative to the board.
translations.终端上升速度作为测得的分运动输入；加速移管时按光滑管壁、竖直运动不变的教材理想条: Terminal rise speed is an input representing measurement. Accelerated tube motion assumes smooth walls and unchanged vertical motion, as in the textbook idealization.

cues.title: 先观察竖直上升
cues.caption: 倒置后先加速，再进入近似匀速阶段。
cues.captionEn: After inversion the float accelerates, then approaches steady rise.
cues.zh: 把玻璃管注满清水，放入红蜡块，用橡胶塞封好开口，再把管倒置。蜡的密度略小于水，蜡块会向上运动。刚开始它会加速，随后水的阻力增大，上升逐渐接近匀速。教材的运动合成分析从这个稳定阶段开始，不能把整个倒置和启动过程都当成匀速运动。
cues.en: Fill the tube with water, insert the red wax float, seal the opening, and invert it. Wax is slightly less dense than water, so it rises. Initially it accelerates; growing water resistance makes its rise approach a steady speed. The textbook’s composition analysis begins in that steady regime, not during the whole inversion and startup process.

cues.title: 边上升边匀速移管
cues.titleEn: Translate the tube while the wax rises
cues.caption: 横向与竖直方向使用同一个时间。
cues.captionEn: Horizontal and vertical components share the same elapsed time.
cues.zh: 蜡块稳定上升时，把玻璃管紧贴黑板向右匀速移动。对着黑板看，蜡块既向右又向上。相同一秒内，水平和竖直方向各增加固定的位移，两者必须使用同一个时间。把每秒的位置点连接起来，会得到一条斜直线。分运动同时发生，不是先横着走，再竖着走。
cues.en: While the wax rises steadily, move the tube right at constant speed against the board. Relative to the board, the wax moves both right and up. Each second adds fixed horizontal and vertical displacements using the same elapsed time. Successive positions form a straight diagonal. Components happen simultaneously, not as a horizontal move followed by a vertical one.

cues.title: 合成位移和速度
cues.caption: 合速度是矢量相加，方向由分速度之比决定。
cues.captionEn: Velocity adds as vectors; their ratio sets its direction.
cues.zh: 从原点到蜡块的位置，可以沿水平和竖直方向作投影。水平位移等于水平速度乘时间，竖直位移等于上升速度乘同一个时间。速度也按矢量合成，合速度大小由两个分速度的平方和开方得到。只要两个分速度都保持不变，比例就不变，所以轨迹方向保持不变，合运动也是匀速直线运动。
cues.en: Project the wax position onto the two axes. Horizontal displacement is horizontal velocity times time; vertical displacement is rise velocity times the same time. Velocities also add as vectors, with combined magnitude from the square root of the sum of their squares. Fixed components keep their ratio and direction fixed, producing uniform straight-line motion.

cues.title: 改成横向匀加速
cues.caption: 竖直等间隔，水平间隔越来越大。
cues.captionEn: Vertical spacing stays equal while horizontal spacing grows.
cues.zh: 现在按教材的理想条件，保持蜡块竖直上升速度不变，让玻璃管从静止开始向右匀加速移动。每秒上升的距离相同，水平位移却依次增大。图上采用练习中的数据：每秒上升十厘米，水平每秒位移依次是四、十二、二十、二十八厘米。合运动不再沿直线，但同一时刻分运动相加的方法仍然成立。
cues.en: Under the textbook’s ideal conditions, keep vertical rise speed fixed and accelerate the tube right from rest. Each second gives the same rise but increasing horizontal travel. This example matches the exercise: ten centimetres upward each second and horizontal increments of four, twelve, twenty and twenty-eight centimetres. The combined path curves, while simultaneous component addition remains valid.
